outcome: Transfer rate to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 532 women with planned midwife-led births at a single department between 2006 and 2019
finding: Midwife-led births, with prompt obstetrician involvement when necessary (43% of cases), were found to be a safe alternative to primarily obstetrician-led births for low-risk pregnancies, resulting in favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes.
